name: common-ink-v2
description: A minimal, keyboard-first workspace for markdown notes, built for people and agents.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run seed && wrangler dev -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --var DEV_USER:dev@localhost --var SEED:1
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run seed && wrangler preview -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
